# @surfaces-ui/sql

Dialect-aware SQL rewriting for sort, filter and paging.

Turns a view (sort, filter, page, group, aggregate, bucket) into SQL for each engine's dialect, with every value bound as a parameter, plus read-only checks.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/sql
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.

Every Surfaces UI package is released at the same version; install them all at that one version, since mixing releases is not supported.
